cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a resort cabana with a shaded daybed by the water — chest-deep in the water; a monastery library of tall wooden shelves — sets a cup down on the surface in front of her; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — sitting on the ground; a present-day immersive planetarium event foyer — testing a small hand-held star projector during an adult celestial-guide costume evening; an outdoor theatre of tiered seats facing a stage — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a Three Kingdoms festival street — standing; a modern flower-lined bicycle promenade beside a canal — taking a break on her own bicycle while watching floating fallen petals; a medieval guild workshop — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a bridal room — holds a small bouquet in both hands at her waist; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — lying on her front; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — standing; an indoor climbing wall of coloured holds — kneeling on the ground
